title: NO remote. Purchased because it's easy to use simplistic, and I'm strategically using 3
text: NO remote. Purchased because it's easy to use simplistic, and I'm strategically using 3. Assembly is a pain Plus I don't know where they're getting this remote control  from because this does not have a remote control Specifically because I have the smaller version 2 years ago now I bought the taller ones and we all know fans will  be slightly noisy however they do the job once you get them assembled..... which isn't as easy as projected , however one has a screw  rolling around you can hear when you turn it upside down or put it flat on the ground inside and I'm just going with it because at this point I'm sick of this whole process, however they do work and it saves me a fortune in air conditioning and stuffy closed rooms so all in all they are nice simplistic push-button fans that are bigger than the one I have and I'm counting on them to save money with air conditioning because I am coming closer and closer to not using this site at all except for very specific things. If you want a simple push button fan this is what you need but I would recommend buying local. Again I do not know why they mentioned remote control it's a very simple easy to use fan and here's hoping the one with the loose screw doesn't screw everything up no pun intended I will check the warranty though because I threw out the box and I'm a call customer service but I'm at the point I spend more time on customer service hold then I do actually using products
